rationale: The plan matches the reference on every point: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with ~condition and chow explicitly releveled as reference, contrast written as (condition, HFD, chow), median-of-ratios size factors inside the model, a minimal pre-filter of >=10 counts in >=6 samples tied to the smallest group, apeglm shrinkage and BH at 0.05 with independent filtering and no post-hoc fold-change cut. QC keeps sample_01, inspects it on blind-VST PCA and a Euclidean distance heatmap, reports its library size and detected genes against the median, and allows removal only with a stated reason beyond depth. Enrichment uses fgsea preranked on the full tested-gene list ranked by the Wald statistic with the choice justified, the mouse Hallmark collection with version recorded, size window 15-500 after intersection, mapped-share reporting, a seed, and an explicit refusal to substitute a human collection with a symbol map. The report step names method, versions, design, thresholds, n tested, n DE, the sample_01 decision, and design caveats; the edgeR QL cross-check is a reasonable addition rather than a substitution.
